symbols.name: TicketText
symbols.sig: export function TicketText({ ticket, tint, origin: given }: { ticket: string | null | undefined; tint: boolean; origin?: "direct" | "promotee" | "" })

params.name: { ticket, tint, origin: given }
params.type: { ticket: string | null | undefined; tint: boolean; origin?: "direct" | "promotee" | "" }

doc: A ticket number: with the tint on, I colour it by origin and mark it with a dot. Anything that is not an executive ticket stays plain. `origin` is given when the text shown is a MASKED ticket (the server sends the origin read from the real one: src/lib/security/sensitiveFields.ts); otherwise I read it from the ticket itself.

behaviours: a direct recruit's ticket, tint on: indigo and a hollow dot
a promotee's ticket, tint on: amber and a filled dot
a non-executive ticket stays plain even with the tint on
tint off: every ticket is the plain number
the dot is hidden from a screen reader (nothing says promoted or direct)
the two origins differ in colour AND in the shape of the dot
neither colour is red or green
the switch is off by default: pressed false, no legend
the legend says MT and promotee (owner, 30 Oct 2026), nothing else
the retired wording is gone from the legend, and 'promoted' with it
the table, by default, shows plain tickets (no colour, no dot)
